meta.name: antinet-doc-parse
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与数据科学家在构建RAG系统时，当需处理PDF/Word/Excel等多格式复杂文档，用此技能可自动触发三级解析降级，一键输出高置信度结构化Markdown与元数据，免去繁琐清洗，直接夯实企业知识库数据底座！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析多格式文档为结构化Markdown
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在构建知识库时需要解析各种格式的文档
copy.tagline_en: Parse multi-format documents into structured Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to parse various document formats for your knowledge base

howto.what: Claude 会把已通过安全扫描的 PDF/Word/Excel 等文件按三级解析自动降级处理，产出结构化 Markdown、元数据与 0–1 置信度；三级全失败时标记人工介入并回传 BLOCKED，不输出残缺结果。
howto.when: 当密卷房 Worker 收到已通过安全扫描的文件，或你给出本地文件路径要求解析文档时接管。输入需为已通过 security-scan 的本地路径。

say.note: 输出 Markdown 正文、元数据与置信度

say.text: 只按 PDF 和 Word 解析，格式白名单限定这两种
say.note: 按 formats 参数限定格式

say.text: 这次解析最终用了哪个解析器，置信度多少？

howto.what_en: Claude takes files (PDF/Word/Excel etc.) that passed the security scan and runs a three-tier parse with automatic fallback, returning structured Markdown, metadata and a 0–1 confidence score. If all three tiers fail, it marks manual intervention and returns BLOCKED instead of partial output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the mijuanfang Worker receives a file that already passed the security scan, or when you give a local file path and ask for document parsing. Input must be a security-scanned local path.

say_en.text: Only parse PDF and Word, limit the whitelist to those two
say_en.note: Restricts formats via the formats argument

say_en.text: Which parser was finally used, and what is the confidence?
